review: The saved-mail display classifier declares its minimal read-only row-kind input, including three legacy labels it already classifies. Current live-mail schemas, output conditions and authority are unchanged.
The inventory callback accepts the existing slice interface so it can count a valid category with no current entries; the expression and result are unchanged.
Live transport fixtures preserve offer as a literal SDP type. The data-channel test retains its callback in a mutable holder, and the toolbar fixture uses the existing runtime-picker builder.
The backend guard test now checks absence of the undeclared ask_entrypoint_required property directly, retaining the negative authority assertion instead of broadening a request contract.
limits: Unfrozen, unpublished, uninstalled. Two production changes are type-only; emitted-code equality is checked separately.

Export validation loads the selected production helpers and changed fixture bodies, with remaining runtime dependencies and source-path assertions canonical. Mocked transport tests do not open a microphone or call a provider.
